mapper.select: SELECT id, after_sale_id, received_by, received_at, inspection_result, inspector_id, inspected_at, abnormal_reason, reissue_no, refund_amount, refund_result, operator_id, finalized_at, final_note FROM warehouse_record WHERE after_sale_id = #{afterSaleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse_record (after_sale_id, received_by, received_at, inspection_result) VALUES (#{afterSaleId}, #{receivedBy}, #{receivedAt}, 'PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse_record SET reissue_no = #{reissueNo}, refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, refund_result = #{refundResult}, operator_id = #{operatorId}, finalized_at = #{finalizedAt}, final_note = #{finalNote} WHERE after_sale_id = #{afterSaleId}
